description: [非官方]《鸣潮》（Wuthering Waves）正式服已实装自机角色风格化贴图审计、隔离 Blender 沙盒卡通渲染与游戏内动作表情展示及标准化 UE 交接包管线（通用 Agent 包体 + 标准 SKILL.md 双形态，无需本机安装 Unreal Engine）。

compliance_policy.ip_owner: Kuro Games (广州库洛科技有限公司)

self_audit.purpose: Verifies AST integrity, manifest/SOP consistency, bundled open-source decoders (Zlib-ng/Detex/ACL), third-party GPL/Apache license notices, absence of proprietary DLLs, remote key URLs, leaked dev paths, or bundled AES keys.

stages.name: preflight_and_sandbox_gate
stages.verify_gate: VerifyGate 0 (Self-Audit + Local WW Official Client Hard Gate + Local FModel Link & Key Check + Blender/Oodle Detection or Consent Bootstrap + Isolated Sandbox Smoke Test)
stages.on_patched: Display host_notice clearly to host user before continuing.
stages.on_consent_required: Pause and present consent_actions (if missing keys, inform host plugin does not provide/search keys so host may disable plugin & open a new session or locate keys manually, OR pass an existing local .json/.zip/.txt/folder path directly via --keys-file without questioning origin).
stages.on_invalid_keys: If HOST_KEYS_INVALID is returned, inform host clearly: 密钥本身存在问题，请使用正确可用的密钥.
stages.on_missing_game: Abort immediately without attempting to download Wuthering Waves.

stages.name: local_aes_check_and_character_parsing
stages.verify_gate: VerifyGate 1 (Local-only AES mount check + pause if expired + .uemodel / MI JSON / Textures / .ueanim binary tracks & curves verification)
stages.on_consent_required: Pause and ask host user to supply updated local .json/.zip key package and re-link FModel with --keys-file + --consent-link-fmodel.

stages.name: texture_three_tier_audit
stages.verify_gate: VerifyGate 3 (MI JSON -> Regex -> Pixel Stats via Blender Python OIIO/numpy; _N BC5+BC7 split; _SDF variance & mirror correlation; _D RGBA & alpha semantics; all-zero detection)

stages.name: blender_stylized_showcase_and_fbx_roundtrip
stages.verify_gate: VerifyGate 2 (Sandboxed Blender .uemodel import + Stylized Toon Shader + .ueanim + RibbonAnim merge + v10 Shape Key curves + cross-frame motion delta verification + non-blank preview renders + Rest-Pose FBX round-trip verification)

stages.name: handoff_packaging_and_delivery_report
stages.verify_gate: VerifyGate 4 (handoff_manifest.json v0.1.0 + DELIVERY_REPORT.md + optional ue_handoff_reference.py AST check + artifact checksums)
